EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
We are pleased to announce the introduction of our FRE® Lush and Sweet 3mg and 6mg Nicotine Pouches. This exciting new addition to the FRE® Nicotine Pouch family.
FRE® Nicotine Pouches offer a complete assortment designed to meet a wide range of consumer preferences. Available in strengths ranging from 3MG to 15MG. FRE® delivers variety across five distinct styles: Mint, Wintergreen, Lush, Sweet, and Original. Please refer to the link below for the full lineup of FRE® SKUs available for order.
FRE SALES SHEET
As one of the fastest-growing nicotine pouch brands on the market, FRE® continues to lead the category with:
FRE’s unique pre-primed moisture technology delivers rapid nicotine and flavor release, offering a convenient, discreet, and modern alternative to the dry, stale pouches currently on the market. Expanded strength options ranging from 3MG–15MG 20 pouches per can — that’s 33% more than the 15-pouch standard offered by leading competitors Exceptional customer loyalty and repeat purchase rates Proprietary technology that delivers measurable performance advantages competitors simply cannot match FRE® is more than just another nicotine pouch — it is a growing family of solutions designed to elevate the nicotine pouch experience.
If you have any questions, please reach out.
Best,
